definitions.explanation: The closing period of the year, typically referring to December and especially the last few weeks. Carries a sense of busyness and urgency as the year draws to a close.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}の{瀬|せ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}って→迫る：03928_semaru⟧きた。
examples.english: The end of the year is approaching.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}の{瀬|せ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧で⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: The year-end is busy with shopping.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}の{瀬|せ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{押|お}し{迫|せま}り→押し迫る：27886_oshisemaru⟧、⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}め⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: With the end of the year closing in, I need to start the big year-end cleaning.

notes:
USAGE:
{年|とし}の{瀬|せ} evokes the feeling of time rushing forward like a river current ({瀬|せ} means "rapids" or "shallows"). It conveys the busyness and emotional weight of the year-end period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年|とし}の{瀬|せ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (the year-end approaches)
- {年|とし}の{瀬|せ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{押|お}し{迫|せま}る→押し迫る：27886_oshisemaru⟧ (the year-end is closing in)
- {年|とし}の{瀬|せ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach the year-end)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese year-end is marked by ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧ (thorough house cleaning), ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧ (New Year's cards), and preparations for ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year).
